rules.title: jev-core is synchronous by construction
rules.text: `jev-core` is "synchronous by construction: no async runtime, no LSP types, no transport" — async belongs in the shell, so the core stays pure steps (its module doc).

judgement.question: Is this async by construction — an `async` item, an await, or a tokio call — which `jev-core` refuses by construction, rather than a doc comment or a string that merely mentions the word?

criteria.true: the line itself is async: an `async` item, an `.await` expression, or a `tokio` call executed in this crate
criteria.false: it is inside a doc comment, a string literal, or test code that only names the word
